reviews.body:
### 🟡 Changes recommended The replacement test contains only uppercase keys, so it would not catch a regression from case-insensitive to case-sensitive matching without a lowercase duplicate.
1 open issue - [Add lowercase duplicate to verify case-insensitive proxy removal](https://github.com/FiligranHQ/xtm-composer/pull/230#discussion_r4683986157) · New
What changed in this PR This PR addresses #170 by preventing duplicate proxy variables when Composer deploys connectors whose OpenCTI contracts already include proxy settings. **Changes:** - Replaces existing proxy entries case-insensitively with Composer’s resolved values. - Leaves contract values unchanged when Composer provides no override. - Adds a regression test for proxy replacement and deduplication. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `src/​api/​mod.rs` | Adds a proxy replacement helper and a regression test for Composer precedence. |
Review effort: Balanced

review_comments.body: The new case-insensitive matching is not covered: this fixture contains only uppercase keys, so changing `eq_ignore_ascii_case` to a case-sensitive comparison would still pass every replacement assertion. Add a lowercase duplicate alongside the uppercase `HTTP_PROXY` entry so the existing count assertion verifies that both spellings are removed.
